chapter: Neko Is a Cat: Cat and Stone
act_title: Neko Is a Cat: Cat and Stone

quests.title: Neko Is a Cat: Cat and Stone

dialogue.t: Your timing is impeccable. I need your aid once more.
I desire...
That you place a tall, large stone shaped in my own image beside this shrine.
Where are we supposed to find something like that...
Whatever the case, I desire something similar to those fox stones on that island far, far away.
Hibiki used to say that there were lots of them on that island, and even asked if I would like one made in my image.
I feel that if Hibiki wanted it, it must be good. As such, I ask you to have one such stone made.

dialogue.sit: I don't have any skill in carving...
Well, I guess we could go look for Taisuke...

dialogue.t: Hmmm, what are we gonna do...
Right, why don't we ask Taisuke? He likes cats a lot. He might even be willing to take up carving just to help Neko!
I will leave the matter of stone to you.
Ah, hello there. What are you busy with today?
Uh... What? A statue, here? Really?
I—I'll pick up carving immediately!

dialogue.sit: I doubt you'll make it in time...

dialogue.t: Hmm, is this another one of Neko's requests?
You know what, I don't think it'll be that hard to find craftsmen looking for work, what with the issues we've been having in Tatarasuna.
The Guild's received quite a few commissions related to this, and I've heard that some people are still in Tatarasuna looking for work.
I encountered just such an encampment while on a commission.
So if you want, you can try your luck there.

dialogue.sit: You don't seem like your usual self, Etsuko.

dialogue.t: Heh, don't pay it any mind. It wasn't that hard.
And you know what? I'd like to see what might happen if that shrine really does thrive again...
Especially that "Hibiki" Neko keeps talking about. What sort of person could be so beloved by that cat?
Alright, don't worry, I'm just talking to myself. Go look for that artisan.
As for whether they know how to carve rock or not... Well, I guess that's up to luck, eh?
Come on, Miss Etsuko, you just want to help Lady Neko as well, don't you? Haha, you're such a—
Taisuke, is our survey plan ready yet?
Uh, I—I'm almost done. Sorry...
*sigh* When will I be able to find some work...
Are you looking for me? What is this about?

dialogue.sit: Do you know how to make stone carvings?
We're looking for an artisan who can work with stone.

dialogue.t: Eh? Well... Well then, that's great!
Wait, sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Ooshima Junpei, and I used to work at Tatarasuna.
After that accident, we were all evacuated.
But till now, I haven't received any notice that we might be returning to work, so I've been idle here this whole time.
So you're looking for someone who can do some stone carving, right? Well, that's not my specialty per se, but I do have some skill in it...
What sort of stone carving do you need made? Could you tell me?
Uh... So, let me get this straight. A talking cat wants you to find a craftsman to make a carved statue of it?
It's not like I don't believe you or anything. It's just a bit... You know, outrageous...
And even if I agreed, how is that... that provisional head priestess supposed to pay me? I'm not going to work for free, no matter what anyone says.
(...Will it really, though...)
Will it? I... Hmm, it just feels like you're swindling me...
Still... You know what? Never mind. I'm a pair of idle hands anyway. Might as well go with you to have a look.
I really hope that I can get paid...
Ah, you have returned. This human must be the stone human, yes?

dialogue.sit: This is the artisan we hired.

dialogue.t: ...What!? The cat... it really can talk!
Meow meow meow, such ado about nothing... Is it so strange that I speak?

dialogue.sit: No need to make a fuss.

dialogue.t: Wait. Are you saying that this is something super normal for you!?

dialogue.sit: That certainly has been the case so far.

dialogue.t: What in the world have you experienced...
Come now, we are not here to merely talk.
Back to our main point. Stone human, can you knock on stone and cause it to look like me?
Eh? Stone human? You mean me?
"Knock on stone," you say... Well, I can give stone-working a go...
Is that so? Wonderful, meow meow meow.
S—So this is how it is, huh... Well, having a job is better than nothing. I mean, I've never worked for a cat before, so... I guess we'll just discuss my salary later?
Hmm. Either way, I'll need to make some preparations. There are quite a few rocks here on this island. I'll need to pick a good one.
Ah, yes. How should I address you?
I am the Neko, the provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine.
As to terms of address, you may call me whatever you please, tall, stone-knocking human.
Is that so? Well then, I suppose I shall call you Lady Priestess. You are my employer, after all.
...What is an "envoyer"?
W—Well, I'll go look around and pick a rock to use, then. You all just stay here for now.
Working for a cat. Well, that's a first...
Mr. Ooshima seems to have forgotten all about that payment.
Still, I am curious. How will a thing as hard as stone take on my countenance?
Is that stone human very powerful? Can he use some magic?

dialogue.sit: It's like that time with the meal we made...

dialogue.t: Ah, I understand. Lovely!

quests.description: Neko, “Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine,” seems to have business with you…
